protocol: Resolve field class, visible boundary and source-date seams before assigning temporal labels.
Find cloud-screened Sentinel observations close to the actual source acquisition, with before/after context. Suggested +/- 5-day windows below are search starting points, not evidence of burn timing.
Visible/NIR bands are 10 m; SWIR is 20 m. Match CRS, affine transform, pixel alignment and spatial support. Do not equate a downsampled high-resolution RGB screenshot with Sentinel data.
Quantify mixed pixels, field-size effects, domain shift and temporal mismatches. Keep all unreviewed labels provisional.
Freeze geographic/acquisition holdouts before training or selecting by model success.
